namespace.label: Namespace
namespace.description: Vespa document namespace. Groups documents within a document type for access control and distribution. Defaults to "default".

protocol.label: Protocol
protocol.description: Protocol used to connect to the Vespa endpoint, either "http" or "https". Ignored when the Endpoint field already includes a scheme (e.g. "https://…"). Defaults to "http".

vespa_cloud_secret_token.label: Vespa Cloud Secret Token
vespa_cloud_secret_token.description: Authentication token for Vespa Cloud. Used as an alternative to mTLS certificate authentication. Leave blank when using client certificates.

client_cert_path.label: Client Certificate Path
client_cert_path.description: Filesystem path to a PEM-encoded client certificate for mTLS authentication. Both this and Client Key Path must be set to enable mTLS; otherwise the hook falls back to token authentication.

client_key_path.label: Client Key Path
client_key_path.description: Filesystem path to the PEM-encoded private key that corresponds to the client certificate. Required together with Client Certificate Path for mTLS authentication.

max_queue_size.label: Max Feed Queue Size
max_queue_size.description: Maximum number of documents to buffer in the pyvespa async feed queue before blocking. Increase for higher throughput at the cost of memory. Uses the pyvespa default when unset.

max_workers.label: Max Feed Workers
max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent worker threads used by the pyvespa async feed client. Uses the pyvespa default when unset.

max_connections.label: Max Feed Connections
max_connections.description: Maximum number of HTTP connections the pyvespa feed client keeps open to the Vespa cluster. Uses the pyvespa default when unset.
